```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(dplyr)
library(sandwich)
library(lmtest)
library(stargazer)
library(emmeans)
library(ggplot2)

# When knitting, working directory = file location; use relative paths
out_dir <- "output"
fig_dir <- "figures"
dir.create(fig_dir, showWarnings = FALSE)
```

```{r load-data}
d_asu <- read.csv('/path/to/local-user/ASU Dropbox/Katsiaryna Siamionava/Research_ASU/Claude_experiments/Robot co-creation/Codes/output/d_asu_final.csv')
d_osu <- read.csv('/path/to/local-user/ASU Dropbox/Katsiaryna Siamionava/Research_ASU/Claude_experiments/Robot co-creation/Codes/output/d_osu_final.csv')
d_asu$version_enc <- relevel(as.factor(d_asu$version_enc), ref = "no_av")
d_osu$version_enc <- relevel(as.factor(d_osu$version_enc), ref = "no_av")

cat("ASU N =", nrow(d_asu), " | OSU N =", nrow(d_osu), "\n")
```


# 1. Service Quality Regressions

```{r serv-qual-models}
model1 <- lm(serv_qual ~ wd_flag * version_enc +
               robot_comfort + age + gender + racewhite + educ + subj_stress1,
             data = d_asu)

model2 <- lm(serv_qual ~ wd_flag * version_enc +
               robot_comfort + age + gender + racewhite + educ + subj_stress1,
             data = d_osu)

robust_se1 <- sqrt(diag(vcovHC(model1, type = "HC1")))
robust_se2 <- sqrt(diag(vcovHC(model2, type = "HC1")))
```

```{r serv-qual-table, results='asis'}
stargazer(model1, model2, type = "latex",
          title = "Service Quality: ASU and OSU (rm_top3_infl)",
          se = list(robust_se1, robust_se2),
          column.labels = c("Study 1 (ASU)", "Study 2 (OSU)"),
          dep.var.labels = "Service Quality",
          omit.stat = c("f", "ser"),
          notes = "HC1 robust standard errors in parentheses.",
          notes.append = FALSE,
          star.cutoffs = c(0.10, 0.05, 0.01))
```

```{r serv-qual-latex, include=FALSE}
# Save LaTeX version for paper
stargazer(model1, model2, type = "latex",
          out = file.path(out_dir, "table_serv_qual.tex"),
          title = "Effect of Avatar Co-Creation and Service Failure on Service Quality",
          label = "tab:serv_qual",
          se = list(robust_se1, robust_se2),
          column.labels = c("Study 1 (ASU)", "Study 2 (OSU)"),
          dep.var.labels = "Service Quality",
          covariate.labels = c(
            "Service failure (wd\\_flag)",
            "Create avatar", "Human avatar", "Animal avatar",
            "Robot comfort", "Age", "Gender (male)",
            "Race (White)", "Education", "Baseline stress",
            "Failure $\\times$ Create avatar",
            "Failure $\\times$ Human avatar",
            "Failure $\\times$ Animal avatar"
          ),
          omit.stat = c("f", "ser"),
          notes = "HC1 robust standard errors in parentheses.",
          notes.append = FALSE,
          star.cutoffs = c(0.10, 0.05, 0.01))
cat("LaTeX table saved to", file.path(out_dir, "table_serv_qual.tex"), "\n")
```






# 2. Manipulation Checks

## 2.1 Avatar Check (X2.5.1 ~ version_enc)

### Study 1 (ASU)

```{r mc-avatar-asu}
mc_av_asu <- aov(X2.5.1 ~ version_enc, data = d_asu)
summary(mc_av_asu)
```

```{r mc-avatar-asu-contrasts}
em_asu <- emmeans(mc_av_asu, ~ version_enc)
cat("Planned contrasts vs. no_av:\n")
contrast(em_asu, method = "trt.vs.ctrl", ref = 1)
```

```{r mc-avatar-asu-tukey}
cat("All pairwise (Tukey HSD):\n")
TukeyHSD(mc_av_asu)
```


## 2.2 Service Failure Check (flawless ~ wd_flag)

### Study 1 (ASU)

```{r mc-failure-asu}
d_asu %>% group_by(wd_flag) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), mean = round(mean(flawless, na.rm=TRUE), 3),
            sd = round(sd(flawless, na.rm=TRUE), 3), .groups="drop") %>%
  mutate(condition = ifelse(wd_flag==1, "Wrong drink", "Correct drink"))

tt_asu <- t.test(flawless ~ wd_flag, data = d_asu)
print(tt_asu)

g0 <- d_asu$flawless[d_asu$wd_flag == 0]
g1 <- d_asu$flawless[d_asu$wd_flag == 1]
cat(sprintf("Cohen's d: %.3f\n",
  (mean(g1, na.rm=TRUE) - mean(g0, na.rm=TRUE)) /
  sqrt((var(g0, na.rm=TRUE) + var(g1, na.rm=TRUE)) / 2)))
```

### Study 2 (OSU)

```{r mc-failure-osu}
d_osu %>% group_by(wd_flag) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), mean = round(mean(flawless, na.rm=TRUE), 3),
            sd = round(sd(flawless, na.rm=TRUE), 3), .groups="drop") %>%
  mutate(condition = ifelse(wd_flag==1, "Wrong drink", "Correct drink"))

tt_osu <- t.test(flawless ~ wd_flag, data = d_osu)
print(tt_osu)

g0 <- d_osu$flawless[d_osu$wd_flag == 0]
g1 <- d_osu$flawless[d_osu$wd_flag == 1]
cat(sprintf("Cohen's d: %.3f\n",
  (mean(g1, na.rm=TRUE) - mean(g0, na.rm=TRUE)) /
  sqrt((var(g0, na.rm=TRUE) + var(g1, na.rm=TRUE)) / 2)))
```

# 3. Fitbit Analysis

**Fitbit1** = HR before interaction; **Fitbit2** = HR after interaction.
ASU Fitbit data joined from interview/LIWC file; OSU from survey CSV.

Five operationalizations of the Fitbit DV:

| Variable | Definition |
|---|---|
| `fitbit_diff` | Fitbit2 − Fitbit1 (raw bpm change) |
| `fitbit_pct` | % change = (Fitbit2 − Fitbit1) / Fitbit1 × 100 |
| `fitbit_hi_mean` | 1 if diff > mean(diff) — LPM |
| `fitbit_hi_med` | 1 if diff > median(diff) — LPM |
| `fitbit_hi_q75` | 1 if diff > 75th percentile(diff) — LPM |

## 3.1 Construct Fitbit DVs

```{r fitbit-dvs}
make_fitbit_dvs <- function(d) {
  d$fitbit_diff    <- d$Fitbit2 - d$Fitbit1
  d$fitbit_pct     <- ifelse(d$Fitbit1 == 0 | is.na(d$Fitbit1), NA,
                             (d$Fitbit2 - d$Fitbit1) / d$Fitbit1 * 100)
  diff_vals        <- d$fitbit_diff
  d$fitbit_hi_mean <- as.integer(diff_vals > mean(diff_vals,   na.rm = TRUE))
  d$fitbit_hi_med  <- as.integer(diff_vals > median(diff_vals, na.rm = TRUE))
  d$fitbit_hi_q75  <- as.integer(diff_vals > quantile(diff_vals, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE))
  d
}

d_asu <- make_fitbit_dvs(d_asu)
d_osu <- make_fitbit_dvs(d_osu)

cat("ASU — N with Fitbit data:",
    sum(!is.na(d_asu$Fitbit1) & !is.na(d_asu$Fitbit2)), "of", nrow(d_asu), "\n")
cat("OSU — N with Fitbit data:",
    sum(!is.na(d_osu$Fitbit1) & !is.na(d_osu$Fitbit2)), "of", nrow(d_osu), "\n")
```

## 3.2 Descriptives

```{r fitbit-desc}
cat("ASU:\n")
summary(d_asu[, c("Fitbit1","Fitbit2","fitbit_diff","fitbit_pct")])

cat("\nOSU:\n")
summary(d_osu[, c("Fitbit1","Fitbit2","fitbit_diff","fitbit_pct")])
```



## 3.4 Regression Tables (ASU vs. OSU)

```{r fitbit-tables, results='asis', warning=FALSE}
ctrl_rhs   <- "robot_comfort + age + gender + racewhite + educ + subj_stress1"
fitbit_dvs <- c("fitbit_diff","fitbit_pct",
                "fitbit_hi_mean","fitbit_hi_med","fitbit_hi_q75")
for (dv in fitbit_dvs) {
  f      <- as.formula(paste(dv, "~ wd_flag * version_enc +", ctrl_rhs))
  m_asu  <- lm(f, data = d_asu )
  m_osu  <- lm(f, data = d_osu)
  se_asu <- sqrt(diag(vcovHC(m_asu, type = "HC1")))
  se_osu <- sqrt(diag(vcovHC(m_osu, type = "HC1")))

  stargazer(m_asu, m_osu, type = "text",
            title = paste("Fitbit DV:", dv),
            se = list(se_asu, se_osu),
            column.labels = c("ASU", "OSU"),
            
         
            omit.stat = c("f","ser"),
            star.cutoffs = c(0.10, 0.05, 0.01))
}
```
